title: viburnum sargentii f. intermedium
intro: Viburnum sargentii f. intermedium, commonly known as Sargent's Viburnum, is a plant species belonging to the Adoxaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The plant is known to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Sargent's Viburnum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
